company_definition: Consolidated completed orders across Food Delivery, Quick Commerce and Out-of-Home Consumption; excludes Platform Innovations.
implementation_notes: Reported definition; platform scope, not all company segments.

company_definition: Consolidated Gross Order Value of completed orders for Food Delivery, Quick Commerce and Out-of-Home Consumption; excludes Platform Innovations.
implementation_notes: Do not label simply Consolidated GOV; this is the B2C consumer-facing scope.

company_definition: Consolidated Adjusted Revenue of Food Delivery, Quick Commerce and Out-of-Home Consumption; excludes Platform Innovations.
implementation_notes: Different from Consolidated Adjusted Revenue of all businesses.

company_definition: B2C Adjusted EBITDA divided by B2C GOV.
implementation_notes: Not the same as consolidated Adjusted EBITDA divided by B2C GOV.

company_definition: Revenue from operations across Food Delivery, Quick Commerce, Out-of-Home Consumption, Supply Chain & Distribution and Platform Innovations.
implementation_notes: All segments, including Supply Chain and Platform Innovations.

company_definition: Adjusted Revenue across Food Delivery, Quick Commerce, Out-of-Home Consumption, Supply Chain & Distribution and Platform Innovations.
implementation_notes: Reconciliation includes user delivery charges and fee from users.

company_definition: Profit/loss as per financials excluding tax expense, depreciation and amortisation expense, and finance cost.
implementation_notes: Company definition.

company_definition: Consolidated EBITDA excluding other income, exceptional items, share in net loss of an associate, share-based payment expense and rental expenses pertaining to Ind AS 116 leases.
implementation_notes: Definition differs from unadjusted financial EBITDA.

company_definition: Number of unique transacting users that completed at least one order on Swiggy unified app/website in a month, averaged over months in the period/year.
implementation_notes: Q1FY27 value discrepancy between Q1FY27 and Q2FY27 letters.

company_definition: Completed orders per user in a month, averaged over months in the period/year.
implementation_notes: Historical values differ across some letters; see source_conflicts.csv.

company_definition: Total completed Food Delivery orders on the platform.
Total monetary value of completed Food Delivery orders, gross of discounts, plus user delivery charges (net of discounts), packaging charges, fee from users and taxes; excludes tips.
implementation_notes: Swiggy does not publish Food Delivery NOV in these letters.

company_definition: Food Delivery GOV divided by Food Delivery Total Orders.
implementation_notes: AOV definition; source tables in this corpus do not publish a full food AOV series.

company_definition: Includes pre-agreed restaurant commissions, restaurant advertising, user/delivery-partner platform fees and subscription revenue (net of specified discounts/credits/refunds), and restaurant business-enablement fees.

Food Delivery Revenue plus user delivery charges collected and passed on to delivery partners (net of discounts) plus fee from users collected and netted off from platform-funded discounts for corresponding orders.
Food Delivery Adjusted Revenue less delivery and other charges, platform-funded discounts and other variable costs, expressed as a percentage of GOV.
implementation_notes: Cost components are not interchangeable with Quick Commerce or Out-of-Home.

company_definition: Food Delivery segment results as per financials less rental expenses pertaining to Ind AS 116 leases.
Unique users with at least one completed Food Delivery order in a month, averaged across months in the period/year.
Unique restaurant partners with at least one delivered order in a month, averaged across months in the period/year.
Total completed Quick Commerce orders on the platform.

Total monetary value of goods at MRP (except where MRP is not applicable, such as fruits/vegetables, where final selling price is used), gross of discounts, plus user delivery charges, packaging charges, fee from users and taxes; excludes tips.
Gross Order Value less discounts, whether platform-funded or partner-funded.
implementation_notes: Company states NOV is intended to better reflect actual consumer spending where non-grocery discounts are structurally higher.

company_definition: Quick Commerce GOV divided by Quick Commerce Total Orders.
implementation_notes: Do not confuse with nAOV label shown in highlights; nAOV definition not found in the standard glossary.

company_definition: Includes merchant commissions, brand advertising, platform/technology fees and subscription revenue, and merchant business-enablement fees.
Quick Commerce Revenue plus user delivery charges collected and passed on to delivery partners, plus relevant user fees netted off platform-funded discounts.
Quick Commerce Adjusted Revenue less delivery and other charges, platform-funded discounts, cost of fulfilment services and other variable costs, expressed as a percentage of GOV.
implementation_notes: Includes fulfilment services explicitly; not the same formula as Food Delivery.

company_definition: Quick Commerce segment results as per financials less rental expenses pertaining to Ind AS 116 leases.
Number of dark stores with at least one completed order on the last day of the period/year.
implementation_notes: Exit count, not average count.

company_definition: Total area of active dark stores on the last day of the period/year.
implementation_notes: Period-end metric.

company_definition: Total transactions on Swiggy Dineout and Swiggy Scenes.
Total monetary value of transactions on Dineout and Scenes, gross of discounts, plus user fees and taxes.
Out-of-Home Consumption GOV divided by total transactions.
Includes restaurant commissions, advertising revenue, user platform fees/subscription revenue, ticket sales and business-enablement fees.
Revenue plus user fees collected and netted off platform-funded discounts for corresponding orders, as applicable.
Out-of-Home Adjusted Revenue less platform-funded discounts and other variable costs, expressed as a percentage of GOV.
implementation_notes: Different cost structure from Food and Quick Commerce.

company_definition: Out-of-Home segment results as per financials less rental expenses pertaining to Ind AS 116 leases.
Unique Swiggy Dineout restaurants listed with payment option in a month, averaged across months in period/year.
Total monetary value of goods sold to wholesalers/retailers plus revenue from supply chain management and enablement services.
implementation_notes: Lynks Logistics sale changes reported segment perimeter from Q3FY27.

company_definition: Supply Chain & Distribution segment results as per financials less rental expenses pertaining to Ind AS 116 leases.
Revenue typically includes sale of food/products, user/delivery-partner fees and subscription revenue, advertising fees and business-enablement fees.
implementation_notes: Includes experiments such as Toing; Snacc was shut down.

company_definition: Revenue from operations plus user delivery charges passed through to delivery partners and applicable user fees netted off platform-funded discounts.
Platform Innovations segment results as per financials less rental expenses pertaining to Ind AS 116 leases.
